title: Legal Ownership: Property cards to enable financial empowerment and dispute resolution.
summary: Schemes — Legal Ownership: Property cards to enable financial empowerment and dispute resolution.

items:  Initial pilot in 9 states, including Rajasthan, Haryana, and Uttar Pradesh.
 Legal ownership of land for rural residents.
 Reduced disputes and modernized land management.
 Enables financial benefits through property-based loans.
